-- Cleanup is done. Amending the original build so a stale lock cannot stop it again:
-- a new step 2 removes hello/build.lock before make runs.
old = jobs~find('build hello')
p = old~amend('build hello, attempt 2')
s = p~insertStep(2, 'clear stale lock'); s~does(ws, 'remove', .Array~of('hello/build.lock'))
jobs~submit(p)
return p
